whenToUse: A breaking-news or "Trending now" strip under a news masthead.
A short rotating list of headlines that must pause on hover, focus and reduced motion.
avoidWhen: Long lists of stories — use post-card or post-modules.
a11y: Has a pause button and pauses on hover and focus; never starts under prefers-reduced-motion (WCAG 2.2.2).
Headlines are announced only while paused, so it never chatters.
